outOfCatalogueRoots.name: enrollment
outOfCatalogueRoots.justification: Never writes to GitHub: EnrollmentApplication.tryRun (EnrollmentApplication.fs) hands every verb to V2EnrollmentCommands.run, which creates only new owner-only local files through V2Custody.createExclusive (CreateNew, mode 0600, no overwrite) and reads GitHub only through V2NativeResolve.getArguments, whose argument vector is an exact-endpoint allowlist of ten GET paths and always carries `--method GET` with no field, input or GraphQL flag. It runs git read subcommands (cat-file, rev-parse, show, log) and, for the routine gates, python3 on copies of check-claim-generation.py, lib/gate.py and check-closing-keywords.py extracted by `git show <base>:<path>` into a private temp directory; those gates only read and print. Its output is a closed refusal code or a local file; it grants no enrollment, admission or implementation authority.

outOfCatalogueRoots.name: route-preflight
outOfCatalogueRoots.justification: Never writes: EnrollmentApplication.tryRun passes it to V2EnrollmentCommands.run `preflight`, which prints one JSON verdict document and writes no file. Its native reads are the same exact-endpoint GET allowlist (V2NativeResolve.getArguments); its subprocesses are git read subcommands, python3 on the base-blob copies of the routine and closing-keyword gates in a private temp directory, and the maintained publication coverage audit run only when the checkout's gate bytes equal the live-verified trusted base. None of them mutates GitHub, the Project or the repository.

outOfCatalogueRoots.name: board-v2
outOfCatalogueRoots.justification: Mixed. refresh sends the one fixed Observation single-select update; migration-apply sends Project administration mutations; inspect, migration-prepare and migration-readback send none. BoardV2Application.tryRun routes by sub-command (BoardV2Application.fs:858-890). The writing routes (refresh, migration-apply, tend --apply) take the shared Project writer lock V2WriterLock (flock(2) on $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/fsgg/board-writer-<project>.lock plus the legacy /tmp lock) before any send, and refuse without it.

routes.name: refresh
routes.justification: The bounded refresh wrapper forwards SendMutation (BoardV2Application.fs:818), but the live transport is V2ObservationTransport.createLive, whose composed SendMutation passes only V2ObservationTransport.authorize (V2ObservationTransport.fs:35-49): the fixed updateProjectV2ItemFieldValue document setting Observation=Verified, after a fresh item/project/content identity read. The target cohort is declared by the binding (SelectedIssues) and is pinned to the reviewed three-target pilot or four-target successor only for BindingVersion 2 (validateScope, V2ObservationTransport.fs:27-33); for other binding versions the fresh item must still match the binding's own SelectedIssues and, for version 3 or a programme binding, its Repositories (V2ObservationTransport.fs:68). Anything else is Malformed; retry is refused.

routes.name: tend
routes.justification: Plan-only unless --apply (#5136 phase 2 PR 4): reads go through V2TendReads.readOnly, which admits only GraphQL documents whose parsed operations are queries. With --apply, BoardV2Application.executeTend sends only when $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/fsgg/board-tend.json exists with mode 0600 and lists rules (contract-gated rules dropped until PR 6), and only while it holds the shared writer lock V2WriterLock (LOCK_NB; a held lock gives a plan-only run). Every send is a V2TendWrite.TendChange rendered to fixed documents and passed through V2TendWrite.allowlisted over HttpTransport.SendMutationOnce: the parsed root fields must be the five Project 3 item mutations (updateProjectV2ItemFieldValue, clearProjectV2ItemFieldValue, addProjectV2ItemById, deleteProjectV2Item, archiveProjectV2Item) with projectId bound to $project = Project 3, or addComment/closeIssue alone, with no literal, for an issue whose C1 close is running. Each send is preceded by an item re-read and a durable possible-send record under $XDG_STATE_HOME/fsgg/board-tend and followed by a readback; it is never retried. GR rewrites the merge gate's custody records under $XDG_STATE_HOME/fsgg/board-gate. With "propose": true in the enable file it also posts at most one comment per run to FS-GG/.github#4985 through the same allowlist, whose only REST route is POST repos/FS-GG/.github/issues/4985/comments with a body of exactly {body} carrying the fsgg:board-tend-proposals/v1 marker once; the run and its proposal IDs are recorded in $XDG_STATE_HOME/fsgg/board-tend/proposals.json before the post, which is never repeated or edited. Its other local writes are the plan and outcomes files (privateJson, exclusive 0600).

routes.name: inspect
routes.justification: Uses V2ProjectionSource.createInspectionTransport (BoardV2Application.fs:884), whose SendMutation returns 'mutation is unavailable' (V2ProjectionSource.fs:657).

routes.name: migration-prepare
routes.justification: Plans and reads only; the live migration transport is created for migration-* but prepare reads the scope and Project and writes only the local prepared report (BoardV2Application.fs:489-509).

routes.name: migration-readback
routes.justification: Reads the prepared file and re-reads the Project (BoardV2Application.fs:648); no mutation is built.

routes.name: migration-apply
routes.justification: Sends Project administration GraphQL mutations (createProjectV2Field, updateProjectV2Field, addProjectV2ItemById, updateProjectV2ItemFieldValue, createProjectV2View, updateProjectV2View; V2Migration.fs:699-716) through V2MigrationTransport (HttpMethod.Post, V2MigrationTransport.fs:113). Conditional on a prepared file whose sha256, accountable owner, selection reference and planning window all match (BoardV2Application.fs:318-328, :510).
